note: Bumped to force a CDN purge, not because the CSS changed. On 1 August the origin served the current pages but the Fastly edge kept 10 stale HTML objects — including all three homepages — and returned them on the plain URLs while any query string got the current file. The HTML carries no cache key of its own, so the only lever is to change the pages themselves: bumping the token rewrites every ?v= on all 130 pages, which makes each page a new object and forces the purge.
